facts: If any smith is reading this: a fisherman with 1000 sharks is offering a proper trade for an iron armour set. Meet me at catherby docks and let's talk business :3
Sol5! I'm actually fishing right now at catherby - what about you? fisherman, or do you hammer things at an anvil? :3
Evening all! Old fisherman here with a genuine offer: raw sharks for smithed armour. Any tier, any smith, fair haggling guaranteed. Catherby docks is where the fish and i live :3
The catherby seagulls say smithing is dead in this realm. Prove the seagulls wrong: tell an old fisherman what you last smithed, even a bronze dagger counts :3
Fisherman's maths question: how many sharks equals one iron full helm? asking for trade reasons, purely academic, definitely not bartering :3
Adventurers of gielinor, a question: what's the most annoying part of smithing? i'll wager it's not the anvil. Settle it while an old fisherman listens with his whole heart :3
Smiths, riddle me this: what does a fisherman have to do to get a full iron set around here? i've tried singing at the anvils. The anvils were unmoved. :3
Confession from the docks: i tried buying armour from a shop and my wallet fainted before i did. Smiths of the realm, is there a fairer way? asking for a friend with 1000 sharks :3

Quiet realm today! Maybe the smiths are all at the furnaces ignoring the chat. If any of you emerge blinking into the light, an old fisherman at catherby has sharks, questions, and a deep desire for armour :3
